paper_title: Axion and neutrino bounds improved with new calibrations of the tip of the red-giant branch using geometric distance determinations
notes: Stellar (red-giant branch tip) bound on axion-electron coupling g_ae. NGC 4258 gives g_ae < 1.6e-13 (95% CL), omega Centauri gives g_ae < 1.3e-13 (95% CL). These are mass-independent bounds applicable for axions/ALPs with m_a < ~keV; mass placed nominally at 1 meV but actually applies broadly to light axions. Also constrains neutrino magnetic dipole moment mu_nu (not in enum). g13 = gae/1e-13 parameterization used in paper.
